name: tinyactors
description: Inspect a running tinyactors system, send to it, read its spans and logs, take snapshots, and rehearse and deploy chart versions

tools.name: systems
tools.description: The systems served: each with its charts, and how many actors it holds now.

tools.name: host_stats
tools.description: The host's counters now: actors, hibernated, pools, and per chart its turns, errors and faults.

tools.name: actor
tools.description: One actor now: its record (mailbox, delayed sends, invocations), its state and its variables. A hibernated actor has no state or variables here: use a snapshot.

actor.description: a session id or the name it was spawned with

tools.name: send
tools.description: Send an event to an actor. It returns once the event is in the actor's mailbox; read the effect with actor or a snapshot.

actor.description: a session id or the name it was spawned with

data.description: the event's data, any JSON value

tools.name: ask
tools.description: Send an event and wait for the actor's reply to _event.origin (a <send targetexpr="_event.origin">).

actor.description: a session id or the name it was spawned with

data.description: the event's data, any JSON value

tools.name: trace_watch
tools.description: Trace matching actors at more detail for a while: rules of {chart, actor (a name, * suffix), event, session, detail: summary|decisions|full, values}. Read the spans with traces.

tools.name: trace_unwatch
tools.description: End a watch early.

tools.name: traces
tools.description: The recent spans the host exported (its telemetry), newest last: filter by session or a span name prefix. Needs telemetry in the host's config.

tools.name: logs
tools.description: The recent <log> lines, newest last, for one session or all.

tools.name: services
tools.description: The services (external invocations) that run, by invoking session: type, src, invoke id.

tools.name: end_service
tools.description: End a running service as its service would: done (done.invoke for the actor) or error (error.communication). For a service that will never answer. Destructive.

tools.name: chart_source
tools.description: The SCXML of the current version of a chart, as the application gave it (an image holds no source).

tools.name: compile
tools.description: Compile a draft chart; nothing runs. Returns its diagnostics and a draft id for rehearse and deploy.

name.description: a file name, such as order.scxml

tools.name: deploy
tools.description: Add a draft's image to the live host: new spawns run it at once. With migrate, move the running actors of the chart too, and wait for the result. Destructive: rehearse first.

tools.name: terminate
tools.description: End an actor. Destructive.

actor.description: a session id or the name it was spawned with

tools.name: snapshot
tools.description: Take a snapshot of a system: every actor, its states, mailbox and delayed sends, the variables, and the trace history, at one moment. The snapshot_* tools and rehearse read it without touching the live host.

tools.name: snapshot_summary
tools.description: What a snapshot holds: its versions (segments) and their charts, per chart how many actors rest in each state, and how much trace history it kept.

tools.name: snapshot_actors
tools.description: The actors of a snapshot, filtered by chart, a state they are in (any active state id), status (idle, runnable, hibernated, ...) or name prefix, by session. Paged.

name.description: a prefix of the name an actor was spawned with

tools.name: snapshot_variables
tools.description: The variables of the actors of a snapshot (one session, or those in a chart and state), read from a copy restored from it. A hibernated actor's are in the application's store.

tools.name: snapshot_chart
tools.description: A chart as a snapshot holds it: its states with how many actors rest in each, its transitions (events, conditions, targets) and its data.

tools.name: snapshot_traces
tools.description: The spans of the trace history a snapshot kept (the moments before it was taken), oldest first, the last `limit`: filter by session or a span name prefix. Times are wall time (nanoseconds since the Unix epoch); spans a host had already exported have no names or values given at run time ((unread) for an event the image does not name).

tools.name: rehearse
tools.description: Rehearse a deploy on a copy of a snapshot: restore it with stand-ins for the I/O processors, services and transport, add a draft, migrate a chart to it, then run the copy for advanceMs on a simulated clock. Reports the migration, the states before and after, and what the copy sent and invoked. The live host is not touched.

services.description: how each stand-in service answers, by type: silent (never, the default), done, error (error.communication), or the name of an event it sends back
